name: Almeida Júnior
bio: José Ferraz de Almeida Júnior was a Brazilian artist and designer; one of the first there to paint in the Realistic tradition of Gustave Courbet and Jean-François Millet. The "Dia do Artista Plástico" is celebrated on his birthday. He is the Patron of the 26th chair of the Brazilian Academy of Fine Arts.

paintings.title: Partida da Monção
paintings.story: Estudo para Partida da Monção or Departure for Monsoon is an oil painting on a canvas that was completed in 1897 by Brazilian painter Almeida Júnior, a representation of Brazilian naturalism and realism.
